PolicyStage.description:
The stages that check the country policy, in pipeline order.

The operator can skip the policy for a lead *from* one of them onward
(``companies.policy_skip_from``); a tail cannot contradict itself the way an arbitrary set
could (copy skipped but deliver not would write an email deliver then withdraws).

Back from Microsoft or Google. The page there does not know the workspace, so it comes
from the sign-in this session started; the person must still be allowed to act there.
Erase a person: suppress the address for good and remove what identifies them.
Rewrite the email as the operator asks. Nothing is saved until they approve it.

Throw this email away and have the next run write a new one to the same person.

The email is cancelled and the lead goes back to the email step, which reuses the address it
already has at no cost; the copy step then writes it again under the current rules and news.
